nodes.label: Ponytail
nodes.rationale: Lazy senior-dev mode: lazy means efficient, not careless; the best code is the code never written. Climb a reuse ladder only after tracing the real flow end to end.

nodes.label: YAGNI
nodes.rationale: First rung of the reuse ladder: ask whether the thing needs to be built at all before writing code.

nodes.label: Reuse-First Ladder
nodes.rationale: Stop at the first rung that holds: YAGNI, reuse existing helpers, stdlib, native platform features, installed dependencies, one-liner, then minimum new code.

nodes.label: Root-Cause Bug Fix
nodes.rationale: A report names a symptom. Grep every caller and fix the shared function once; patching only the ticket path leaves sibling callers broken.

nodes.label: ponytail Comment Convention
nodes.rationale: Mark deliberate simplifications that cut a real corner with a known ceiling using a ponytail: comment naming the ceiling and upgrade path.

nodes.label: email-tools
nodes.rationale: Flask web app for reading and triaging an inbox through AI-generated summaries so users do not read email-by-email.

nodes.label: Direct IMAP Inbox Connection
nodes.rationale: Log in with email plus provider App Password to fetch mail from any IMAP server; no file exports required.

nodes.label: Auto-Sort Categories
nodes.rationale: Messages are auto-sorted into buckets such as Urgent, Finance, Work, Alerts, Newsletters, Marketing, and Personal.

nodes.label: Bullet-Point Summaries
nodes.rationale: Each email gets cached bullet summaries via local heuristics or Groq AI; Groq picks the model with the largest available context window.

nodes.label: Local Heuristic Summaries
nodes.rationale: Without a Groq key the app falls back to local heuristic summaries that still work.

nodes.label: EML and MBOX Import
nodes.rationale: File exports are an alternative to direct IMAP sync.

nodes.label: Per-User Groq API Key
nodes.rationale: Recommended: paste the key in Settings; it is stored encrypted and scoped to the account.

nodes.label: Server-Level Groq API Key
nodes.rationale: GROQ_API_KEY env var is used as fallback when a user has not saved their own key.

nodes.label: Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Triage the inbox through summaries instead of threads: connect accounts, auto-sort, cache bullets, and search takeaways.

nodes.label: IMAP Host Auto-Fill
nodes.rationale: Domain map fills imap_host for Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook/Hotmail/Live, and iCloud/me/mac; unknown domains fall back to imap.{domain}.

nodes.label: Account Password
nodes.rationale: App-local password so returning users log in with email plus this password instead of a provider App Password every time. Without it, anyone who knows the email can log in on this server.

nodes.label: Groq API Key Settings
nodes.rationale: Personal Groq key is stored encrypted; empty falls back to the server-level key if configured.

nodes.label: Manual Filter Rules
nodes.rationale: An email is tagged if it matches any rule; fields are sender, recipient, subject, body, category with contains/equals/starts_with/ends_with/not_contains.
